title: gonk operator configuration (instance defaults, group overrides, rung catalog), schema version 1

scopePatterns.description: Repository path patterns, relative to the repository root. `*` and `?` match inside one path segment; `**` as a whole segment matches any number of segments (as the last segment, at least one). No character classes, no escapes, no `.` or `..` segments. See docs/reference/gonk-scope.md.

scopeCaps.description: Size ceilings for a code-writing workflow's change. Each is MINIMISED against the workflow's pack row and every other layer: a value above the pack row's has no effect, a value below it tightens. An absent key says nothing.

max_files.description: Maximum number of files one change may touch.

max_lines.description: Maximum added plus removed lines, counted on the diff the broker computes.

max_deletes.description: Maximum number of files one change may delete.

max_file_bytes.description: Maximum size, in bytes, of a file that may be changed.

max_patch_bytes.description: Maximum bytes of proposed content across the whole change.

pipeline_fixes.description: Operator VETO of pipeline-fix merge requests (gonk-2usw). `false` switches them off for every project under this layer, whatever their .gonk.yml says. `true` grants nothing: only a project can opt in.

reviews.description: Operator VETO of independent review (gonk-cuwn). `false` switches reviews off for every project under this layer, whatever their .gonk.yml says. `true` grants nothing: only a project can opt in. NOT ACTIVE YET: this version of gonk validates and resolves the key and nothing dispatches the workflow.

scope.description: Workflow scope (gonk-066) for this operator layer: tightens every project it applies to. Folded with the workflow's pack row and the project's .gonk.yml `scope:`; no layer can widen past the pack row. An invalid section stops gonk-meter starting. Reference: docs/reference/gonk-scope.md.

classes.description: Path classes a code-writing workflow may write in this scope. INTERSECTED with the workflow's pack row and every other layer, so it can only remove classes; a class the pack row does not list is ignored. An empty list allows none. The protected classes (control, secret, ci) cannot be listed: control and secret are the floor, and ci is reached only through a per-dispatch lift the controller grants.

protected_paths.description: Extra protected paths. A matching path becomes class `control`: no agent may write it and no dispatch can lift it. Unioned across all layers.

ci_paths.description: Extra pipeline-definition paths. A matching path whose built-in class is source, other, test or docs becomes class `ci` (protected; writable only by a dispatch holding the ci lift). A path in any other class is not moved.

test_paths.description: Paths to treat as test code. A matching path whose built-in class is `source` or `other` becomes class `test`; nothing else is moved (gonk-066 Q3: downward reclassification only). Every reclassification is logged.

docs_paths.description: Paths to treat as documentation. A matching path whose built-in class is `source` or `other` becomes class `docs`; nothing else is moved (gonk-066 Q3). Every reclassification is logged.

source_paths.description: OPERATOR ONLY. Paths to treat as source code. A matching path whose built-in class is `other` becomes class `source`. For a language gonk ships a profile for, prefer the project selecting that profile (`scope.profiles`); this key is for what no profile covers. A project's .gonk.yml may not set this.

deny_lift.description: OPERATOR ONLY. Protected classes no dispatch may be granted a lift of, whatever the pack row and the project say. Only `ci` is liftable, so only `ci` can be listed.

allowed_profiles.description: OPERATOR ONLY. The ecosystem profiles (gonk-wj14) projects under this layer may select with `scope.profiles` in their .gonk.yml. ABSENT means the whole shipped menu. INTERSECTED across operator layers (instance, then every matching group), so a layer can only shrink the menu; an empty list allows no profile. A project that names a profile outside the menu has an invalid configuration (no dispatch, no spend) for as long as it does, including a project that was valid before this key changed. A project with no `scope.profiles` key gets the default [go, docs-md] with any disallowed profile removed. This restricts only which profiles' source, test and docs rows a project can turn on: the dependency, test-configuration and generated-file rows of every shipped profile apply to every project and are not on this menu. `scope.profiles` itself is project-only and is refused here. Patterns per profile: docs/reference/gonk-scope.md.

pipeline_fix.description: Pipeline-fix merge requests (gonk-2usw) for this operator layer: tightens every project it applies to. Every key can only TIGHTEN; none can opt a project in to anything, and a value wider than the project's has no effect. Folded onto the project's .gonk.yml `pipeline_fix:`. Reference: docs/reference/gonk-pipeline-fix.md.

classes.description: Diagnosis classes that may be followed by a fix. Default [code, test]. INTERSECTED across layers: an operator list can only remove classes from the project's (or from the default). An empty list allows none. `configuration` additionally needs `allow_ci: true`. A diagnosis classified flaky, infrastructure or unknown is never fixed, and cannot be listed.

targets.description: Which failed pipelines may get a fix: `ref` is a pipeline on the default branch, `mr` a merge request pipeline. Default [ref]; `mr` is a per-project opt-in. INTERSECTED across layers. An empty list allows none.

allow_ci.description: Operator VETO of the CI-definition lift. `false` forbids the lift for every project under this layer, whatever their .gonk.yml says. `true` grants nothing: only a project can opt in. (An operator can also veto it with scope.deny_lift.)

ci_exec_changes.description: What happens to a CI fix that changes what a job EXECUTES (script, image, variables, rules). Default manual-run: the commit carries [skip ci] and a maintainer starts the pipeline. `deny`: such a fix is refused. `auto`: its pipeline runs without a human. The STRICTEST value across layers wins (deny, then manual-run, then auto). Such a fix is never merged automatically under any value. Only meaningful with allow_ci.

max_attempts.description: Attempts at one fix before gonk stops and asks for a human. Default 2, ceiling 3. Each attempt also costs the project a pipeline run. MINIMUM across layers.

max_chain.description: Fix merge requests per red streak, counted since the target was last green. Default 5, ceiling 10. MINIMUM across layers.

verify_timeout.description: How long gonk waits for the fix merge request's pipeline before it reports the fix as unverifiable. A whole number with a unit: s, m or h. Default 2h, ceiling 6h, more than 0. MINIMUM across layers. The meter holds an attempt's budget reservation for this long on top of its usual reservation time.

max_files.description: Files one fix may change. Default and ceiling 3. MINIMUM across layers, and against scope.caps.max_files.

max_changed_lines.description: Added plus removed lines of one fix, counted on the diff gonk computes. Default and ceiling 40. MINIMUM across layers, and against scope.caps.max_lines.

auto_merge.description: Automatic merge of a fix that met its exit criterion. Absent means off: a human merges every fix. gonk never approves and never assigns itself.

mode.description: `off` vetoes automatic merges for every project under this layer. Naming another mode allows ONLY that mode: a project that names a different one gets off. It never switches automatic merging on for a project that did not ask. YAML 1.1 tools read a bare off as false; write "off".

classes.description: Which OBSERVED diffs may be merged automatically, by path class: `docs` (a documentation-only change) and `ci` (a pipeline-definition change that leaves every job's execution unchanged). Default [docs]. INTERSECTED across layers. A diff touching source or test files, and a CI change that alters what a job executes, are never merged automatically and cannot be listed.

max_per_day.description: Automatic merges of fix merge requests gonk may make on a project in any 24 hours. Default and ceiling 3. MINIMUM across layers; a value above the ceiling is refused.

change.description: The issue-to-merge-request workflow (gonk-cuwn) for this operator layer: tightens every project it applies to. Every key can only TIGHTEN; none can opt a project in to anything, and a value wider than the project's has no effect. Folded onto the project's .gonk.yml `change:`. NOT ACTIVE YET: this version of gonk validates and resolves the key and nothing dispatches the workflow. Reference: docs/reference/gonk-change.md.

triggers.description: Which forms of an explicit request start the workflow: `label` (the implement label applied to the issue), `command` (a slash-style command in an issue note), `mention` (an at-mention of the bot asking for implementation). Default: all three. Whatever the form, the request counts only when it was made by a project member with the Maintainer or Owner role; that level is fixed and is not a setting. INTERSECTED across layers. An empty list means nothing starts it. A triage verdict never starts this workflow: `triage-verdict` cannot be listed.

create_classes.description: Path classes (see scope:) in which a change may CREATE a new file. Default [test, docs]: a new test or documentation file. `source` is an opt-in, and the list can never go beyond [source, test, docs]. INTERSECTED across layers. An empty list means a change may only edit files that already exist. Dependency manifests, test-runner configuration, CI definitions and dotfiles cannot be created under any setting.

require_docs.description: When a change to source code must also change documentation. Default when-labelled: required when the issue carries one of `docs_labels`. `always`: for every change that touches source. `never`: not required. The STRICTEST value across layers wins (always, then when-labelled, then never).

docs_labels.description: Issue labels that make documentation required when `require_docs` is when-labelled. Default [feature, enhancement, "type::feature"]. A project list REPLACES the default; an operator layer ADDS labels (union). A label can only add the requirement, never remove it. At most 16 labels of 1 to 255 characters.

require_test_report.description: Default false. `true`: the workflow does not start unless the default branch pipeline publishes a JUnit test report, and a change whose pipeline publishes none is reported as unverifiable instead of verified. `true` in ANY layer applies; `false` in an operator layer grants nothing.

max_attempts.description: Attempts at one issue before gonk stops and asks for a human. Default 2, ceiling 3. Each attempt costs the project a pipeline run. MINIMUM across layers; a value above the ceiling is refused.

max_open.description: Open change merge requests gonk may have on this project at once. Default 1, ceiling 3. Further requests wait. MINIMUM across layers; a value above the ceiling is refused.

verify_timeout.description: How long gonk waits for the change merge request's pipeline before it reports the change as unverifiable. A whole number with a unit: s, m or h. Default 2h, ceiling 6h, more than 0. MINIMUM across layers. The meter holds an attempt's budget reservation for this long on top of its usual reservation time.

max_files.description: Files one change may touch, edited plus created. Default 6, ceiling 8. MINIMUM across layers, and against scope.caps.max_files; a value above the ceiling is refused.

max_changed_lines.description: Added plus removed lines of one change, counted on the diff gonk computes; every line of a created file counts. Default 200, ceiling 300. MINIMUM across layers, and against scope.caps.max_lines; a value above the ceiling is refused.

auto_merge.description: Automatic merge of a change that met its exit criterion. Absent means off: a human merges every change. gonk never approves and never assigns itself. NOT ACTIVE YET: this version of gonk validates and resolves the key and nothing dispatches the workflow.

mode.description: `off` vetoes automatic merges of change merge requests for every project under this layer. Naming another mode allows ONLY that mode: a project that names a different one gets off. It never switches automatic merging on for a project that did not ask. YAML 1.1 tools read a bare off as false; write "off".

classes.description: Which OBSERVED diffs may be merged automatically. For this workflow the only class is `docs`, and it means PROSE ONLY: every changed file is a documentation text file (.md, .rst, .txt, .adoc); a script or configuration file under docs/ does not qualify. Default [docs]; an empty list allows none. A change touching source or test files is never merged automatically and cannot be listed.

max_per_day.description: Automatic merges gonk may make on this project in any 24 hours. Default and ceiling 3. MINIMUM across layers; a value above the ceiling is refused.

review.description: Independent review of gonk-authored merge requests (gonk-cuwn) for this operator layer. `rung` is set HERE and only here: it is the operator's statement of which model is adequate for review. Every other key can only TIGHTEN. NOT ACTIVE YET: this version of gonk validates and resolves the key and nothing dispatches the workflow. Reference: docs/reference/gonk-review.md.

targets.description: Which merge requests are reviewed. `gonk`: merge requests gonk itself authored (pipeline fixes and issue changes) that passed their own exit check. It is the only value: merge requests written by people are not reviewed in this version, and `human` cannot be listed. Default [gonk]. An empty list means nothing is reviewed.

rung.description: OPERATOR ONLY. The ONE rung of the rung catalog every review runs on: the operator's statement of which model is adequate for review. A review never climbs the ladder. Unset means no review can run and `after-agentic-review` is unavailable. It must name a rung in `rungs`. Two layers that apply to a project and name DIFFERENT rungs fold to none. A project's .gonk.yml may not set this.

max_notes.description: Findings one review may report. Default and ceiling 20. A review with more is refused as a whole. MINIMUM across layers; a value above the ceiling is refused.

max_reviews_per_mr.description: Reviews of one merge request, one per head commit. Default and ceiling 3. After that a new head is not reviewed. MINIMUM across layers; a value above the ceiling is refused.
